summary: Bound path matching cost in scope overlap checks

delivery.outcome: Bound repeated path matching in scope-overlap checks without changing findings or authority predicates.
nonGoals: No ticket activity policy, reservation, lease or approval changes
No check retirement, timeout change or runtime deployment
No changes to the separate ticket-446 implementation

architecture.decision: Compute non-governance path membership once per ticket within each overlap-check invocation. Intersect path positions for pairs, preserving duplicate inputs, diagnostic ordering and counts. Retain symbolic pattern overlap checks and the existing shared-path helper. Make the existing unreadable-branch-inventory fixture explicitly invalid with broken Git metadata, independent from its temporary-directory parent. The strict inventory resolver and refusal assertion remain unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Revert the implementation through protected independent publication; no data migration or host operation is involved.

validation.evidence: Findings retain forbidden and governance exclusions, virtual overlaps, duplicate path ordering and exact concrete counts.

Instrumented path matching stays bounded by tickets times files; subsequent invocations observe changed inputs. Confirm the diagnosed 304-ticket, 1760-file workload completes without changing its findings.
Bundled parity, full tests, exact-head/current-base OneDev, Linux, Windows and independent Validator publication.
